label: FREE TOOL
headline: ScreenPal: Easy Screen Recording
body: Create quick tutorials, product demos, or feedback videos for clients. Capture your screen and webcam with ease.
caption:
ScreenPal, formerly Screencast-O-Matic, offers a free version that's great for making short videos. It's perfect for showing how something works or sending visual feedback. Remember to check their current free plan limits for recording time and features. Give visual communication a go!
